name: m4-leyden-noindy
description: Follows `m4-leyden-nolink` (scala `LEYDEN.md`): a cache without class linking matches cold; with linking (no profiles) it costs +6.4% instructions. Is it the class linking or the pre-resolved `invokedynamic` call sites?

`aot-noindy`'s cache is created with `-XX:-AOTInvokeDynamicLinking`: classes AOT-linked, `invokedynamic` left to resolve at run time. Its forks ignore the training profiles (`-XX:-AOTReplayTraining`), so it compares with `aot-noreplay` in `m4-leyden-l2-jit`. Build `1e85ab8eba`, stock JDK 26 integration build, m4.

variantDescriptions.aot-noindy: cache trained by a `-wi 8 -i 5` fork with `-XX:-AOTInvokeDynamicLinking`; profiles not replayed
